fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)

low_power_modes_summary.axi_idle: Manager drives no valid xVALIDs; ACLK gating is implementation-defined.
low_power_modes_summary.ace_idle: No outstanding coherent or snoop traffic; snoop channels' VALIDs LOW; clock gating allowed.
low_power_modes_summary.ace_q_channel_intent: Q-Channel (separate AMBA Low Power Interface, ARM IHI 0068) is typically layered on top of ACE for power-down handshakes; that's outside IHI 0022E scope.

fields.notes: Power-domain partitioning, voltage-domain crossings, power-gate sequencing, isolation cells, retention registers, and Q-Channel low-power handshakes are deferred to SoC integration (UPF / CPF) and to other AMBA documents (e.g., IHI 0068 Q-Channel). IHI 0022E does not define a power-intent layer for AXI/ACE itself. Coherency protocol does require that powered-down masters drop out of the shareability domain cleanly — typically via a domain-membership change at integration.

evidence.quote: Each AXI interface has a single clock signal, ACLK.
Shareability domains are statically defined; the membership must be a single consistent definition system-wide.
